no: Extending the preamble just before X_24537, let m(X) denote the (A,B,C,X_2; A',B',C',X_2) collineation image of X = \(x : y : z\), where A'B'C' = Gemini triangle 37, as in centers X_25962-X_25997. Then m(X) = 2 b c (b + c - a) x + (a - b + c) (a^2 - b^2 + c^2) y + (a + b - c) (a^2 + b^2 - c^2) z : : A point X lies on the Euler line if and only if m(X) also lies on the Euler line; examples: m(X_4) = X_11109 and X_23 = X_11285. (Clark Kimberling, October 29, 2018)
